policy.basis: Every check cites public requirements and contracts. Source references explain provenance, not extra requirements. References alone do not prove semantic coverage; a person must review the mapping.
policy.firstRound: Freeze the original sources, actual read scope, build output and observed results before repairs. Never replace a failed first round with a repaired result.
policy.limits: A recorded result is supplied evidence, not automatic execution or production certification. Do not infer a general accuracy rate or pixel identity from this one case.

checks.description: The page visibly identifies the MOCK pilot. All exercised notice/user/dictionary data and transport are synthetic; no production API, database or real file service is used.

Query conditions occupy the upper panel. The toolbar is below them and above the table: 发布公告 at the left, 查询 and 重置 at the right, with a visible positive gap between adjacent buttons. Do not require a new pixel value absent from the public input.

Title, type, publication start/end and status are usable query controls. Dates display as calendar dates; an inverted interval cannot be submitted as a valid query; empty bounds do not constrain the mock filter.

Entering loads once. Each query sends current filters and page one once. Reset clears all five filter values, returns to page one and sends exactly one query, not an old query followed by another refresh.

Mock requests use noticeTitle/noticeType/pubTimeStart/pubTimeEnd/noticeStatus and current/size; populated type/status filters are exact, title matching is substring and date bounds are inclusive. Records and pager reflect the mock response.

The table shows title, publication unit, type, publication date, status and operations; it supports paging. Draft rows expose 修改, published rows expose 查看, and single deletion follows permissions rather than an invented batch/revoke workflow.
New dialog has title, type, date, unit, multi-select range, files and rich body. Its read-only date is the synthetic clock's today and read-only unit comes from the synthetic current user.

Editing loads noticeId/passKey through view and restores the original title/type/date/unit/ranges/body. Existing files are displayed through the separate mock refer-id echo, not by assuming view.file is rendered. Saving preserves the original publication date and unit rather than replacing them with creation defaults.
A null, empty or absent response range displays as an empty multi-selection without throwing. Normal multi-values remain selected after a failed request and retry.

Draft has a nonempty-title minimum: a blank title shows a validation message and sends no request; a title-only draft can be sent as X5601. Type/range/body/files are not silently made mandatory for this draft case.
Publish requires title, type, publication unit and range. Missing required fields show their validation and send no save. Body/files are optional this round; a valid publish sends X5602.

Create uses JSON POST add and existing records use JSON POST update with the public bounded payload, including noticeId/passKey on update. Range encoding is a comma string in a separate payload, not a destructive replacement of the UI array. File payload is {referType:'SYS1047',fileList:[{attachId}]}; file identities/body values persist in the shared mock store and file registry.
Successful draft/publish shows success, closes the dialog and refreshes the parent exactly once with existing filters and page one. Successful publish becomes published in the shared mock store.
Canceling create/edit and closing either read-only mode do not send saves or list refreshes. Closing is not treated as successful mutation.
The title entry opens reading detail with title/unit/date/files/filtered body and only Close. It does not expose edit/save or silently replace this mode with a different field set.

Published-row view displays all form fields read-only with no draft/publish save controls. Exercise the public mock stale-row scenario: if fresh detail is already published despite a draft list row, the form becomes read-only and cannot save. Missing execution evidence is not-run, never pass.

Action entrances follow ADD/UPDATE/VIEW/DELETE permissions. Missing write permissions also block direct calls to the corresponding page mutation handler; the result is only frontend defensive behavior, not proof of backend authorization.

An authorized single deletion asks confirmation. Cancel sends no delete/refresh. Confirmation sends one noticeIds value and passKey via the observed mock GET consumer interface for either allowed state; it does not claim GET is a new API design standard.
Delete success removes just the target, shows success and refreshes once. Delete failure shows the error and leaves existing list data intact.
A delayed save displays pending state and duplicate clicks cannot create a second request while the first save is pending.
Business failure and rejected request are exercised separately. Both show an error, keep the dialog and all user values, release pending state and allow a successful retry without a range type error.
Failed publish leaves the shared record as draft, keeps editing values and does not preemptively refresh the list or pretend the notice was published.
Detail business failure, missing notice or rejected request is visible as an error; an incompletely loaded edit cannot save.

Mock file identities pass through saving and allowed-extension rich records display their attachName in edit/read-only modes. Existing records load through the mock refer-id query, separate from notice detail. Local synthetic selection/removal is usable in edit mode; real upload/download/preview callbacks never escape the mock harness.
Body is editable in the editable mode, persists through mock saving and is filtered in reading/read-only rendering. Harmless synthetic script markers must not execute when displayed.

Compile the isolated generated page with the public target Vue/FB versions and existing target tooling only. Record the actual command, installed versions, exit code and warnings; absent dependencies are not-run, not a runtime substitution or an automatic install.

Exercise list business failure and rejected request separately: both show an error and preserve the previous records; on initial failure the list stays empty. The table's silent catch is not the baseline, and failure is not displayed as a successful empty query.
